notes.title: Evil Awaits V1.3 - New Game +, New Upgrades, Languages and more!
notes.content:
Evil Awaits 3rd major update is here!
In this update I've added lots of player-requested content such as: New Game+, New upgrades, languages, control options and more.

New Game +
New game Plus is here! Carry over your save, keep all your weapons, and continue upgrading as you restart the adventure through Archdale—this time, with new upgrades to find and stronger enemies to fight.

Upon reaching the end ranking screen on completion of the story of Evil Awaits, you will be given the option to create a New Game+ save in any slot. The number of New Games started within one save will be recorded, and can be seen on any of the save and load screens. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/d3be3f5d84f0738bf48a5d525876052c2b3eaf62.png
(Thats right, you can New Game+ as much as you like!)

Returning Players
If a returning player has completed the game before patch 1.3, and they currently have a save in the level: Castle. They will be eligible to load and create a New Game+ save via a new menu that will appear when you next update and launch Evil Awaits.

New Upgrades
With this update comes 8 brand new journals and upgrades to find, all exclusive to New Game+. Burst Fire, Rate Of Fire, Max Health and more.. Look forward to collecting a brand new way to upgrade and adapt every firearm in the game!

More Subtitle Languages
Subtitles throughout all spoken dialogue in Evil Awaits are now available in 4 additional languages:

 Italian
 French
 Japanese
 Russian

Find the setting to adjust this in the Gameplay section of the Settings menu. (May require a re-load)

Additions and Settings
- Several new sequences have been made to further tease upcoming bosses in levels: Garden and Docks.
- Keybinding is now available for movement keys on Keyboard & Mouse controls.
- Y Axis can now be inverted in the Controls section of the Settings menu.
- Added a small amount of environment pieces to create better collision and pathing in levels: Docks and Castle.
- Rumble variations for players on gamepad have been made for all firearms.
- Gamepad rumble can be turned On and Off via the Controls section of the Settings menu.
- Gamepad rumble added to a cinematic in the level: Forest.
- Gamepad rumble added certain interactions throughout the entire game.
- The achievement 'The Saviour' can now be unlocked via completing the story of Evil Awaits on Hardcore or New Game+.
- Additional Foliage added to Intro cinematic in the level: Forest.
- Additional LoDs added for optimisation in levels: Forest, Cemetery and Chapel.

Balance and Improvements
- Larva enemies chance of dropping loot decreased: 100% -> 80%.
- Reworked the unarmed locomotion to look more fluid and accurate.
- Grabber enemy variant health has been buffed to scale with damage upgrades.
- Grabber enemy variants chance of dropping loot increased: 20% -> 100%.
- Grabber enemy variant can now drop Toolkits.
- Adjusted health scaling of all lesser enemy variants.
- Increased time in between attacks of the second phase of the boss in the level: Docks.
- Decreased overall health when on Standard and Hardcore difficulties of the second phase of the boss in the level: Docks.
- Increased movement speed of a boss in the level: Castle.

Fixes
- Fixed an issue that caused landscape not to load during the opening cinematic in level: Forest.
- Fixed an issue that caused incorrect weapon checks when spawning ammo from certain sources.
- Fixed several subtitle errors when using non-English subtitles.
- Fixed an instance that caused the red laser of firearms to stay on when unequipped.
- Fixed an instance that would stop music from playing in the bear chamber in the level: Castle.
- Fixed an instance that causes Save Slot 3 on the Main Menu to display the wrong information.
- Fixed an instance that allows players to start the boss without the Chapel key in level: Cemetery.
- Fixed an instance that caused the end ranking screen to show incorrect information.

I hope this update introduces some additions, changes and features that players have requested. If you have any feedback, feel free to post in the discussions or reach out to Chai Games (Solo Developer).

Thank you to everyone who has played Evil Awaits and provided positive reviews with feedback.

notes.title: Evil Awaits V1.2 - Costumes, Languages, Optimization and more!
notes.content:
Evil Awaits 2nd major update is here!
With this update, I've brought in lots of player-requested features. These include: unlockable costumes, subtitle language options, optimizations for Steamdeck and more fixes and improvements. 

Closets & Costumes
Closets have been placed into Evil Awaits, and interacting with them will now allow you to change your detective's outfit! 

You can access a Closet at the start of the game in the level: Forest. Or at any time in the level: Garden.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/952914cc57d554da3b74ee8dd8f76cee0ff22de6.png

A total of 7 new Outfits have been added for you to unlock, all with an A and B variation that makes a slight change to the selected costume. Here is a quick preview of one variation from each costume:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/9b5981afe62f35266ce03d1a50610891131b64ef.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/a0339a2aa3f930c615870e2788d45501825dd2d2.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/06e077b85f636985cfd0f22a0cedf80f82f40eb4.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/175197eae277b2082a3f8e82a209395af725100f.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/d2bc22346f816f724901aeec8add1b6d41296d8c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/f5c337157d728b285bae93a4c572c9ba50514830.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/ae78a12524a5bab834350224ef98b6591e2647f2.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/cae0eef661665d74003ebe9301094b2d7d0a141b.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/96d7fc023d904168b8578e00ded11c6be6d5cd35.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/cd0f3195b31fc8e7529b4d6bf8eaa005d9f9585a.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/fb71908ff9fafb65b2ecba87dbb533e4ec578c8c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/45f3da7bcf043caf53544da40640b6acc3f81109.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/bc8f315af24801d9d418034dfa6466440bf75dea.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/4626d5dff89b6122533c580dcd6a6c7636f91465.png

Get instant access to use the Bikini & Cultist costumes via the Costume DLCs now available on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3441250/Evil_Awaits__Cultist_Costume/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3441260/Evil_Awaits__Bikini_Costume/

100% of proceeds made from costume DLCs go directly into the development of Evil Awaits and future Chai Games projects.

Unlock criteria for costumes must have been met after the inclusion of the framework for costumes in Evil Awaits. This means if you played before patch 1.1.2 (8th December), you will need to re-meet the criteria to unlock costumes.

Subtitle Language Setting
Experience the spoken dialogue throughout Evil Awaits in your native language! This was a heavily requested feature from non-English speaking players, and I hope it allows more people to better understand the story they are experiencing.

Available Subtitle Languages:

 German
 Portuguese
 Simplified Chinese
 Spanish

This setting is accessible via the 'Gameplay' tab in the Settings menu.

I hope to introduce more languages into this setting and to extend language options to interface and more in the future. This is a first step into a new system, and if your language is not listed I ask you to remain patient until more updates arrive.

Changes & Optimisation
- Reworked several loot systems to reduce the chance of receiving ammo or medkits if you've reached the max capacity of medkits or ammo for that weapon.
- Crosshair is now available and enabled by default in Hardcore difficulty, option to turn it off in the gameplay tab of the settings menu.
- Increased the Night Brightness in the levels: Forest, Garden, and Cemetery.
- Controls for Both KeyB & Mouse and Controller are now listed in the Controls tab on the Settings menu.
- All UI across the game has been re-adjusted to be visible on smaller resolutions and the Steam Deck. 
- Improved LODs have been made to increase the performance and framerate of levels: Forest, Garden, Cemetery and Archdale Castle.
- Fixed an instance across all UI that didn't allow menu navigation with a controller if the mouse was hovered over a button.
- Added more tips to loading screens.


Fixes and Improvements
- Fixed an instance that caused the flashlight of weapons to stay on when unequipped.
- Using a medkit when you have 0 medkits will no longer unequip your current weapon.
- Font changed when interacting with the boat without the boat paddles in the level: Docks.
- Improved sound effects emitted from Skulls Of Archdale collectables.
- Fixed an issue that displayed '0' amount of journals collected on the end-ranking screen regardless of the amount found during the playthrough.
- Fixed a collision problem that occurred on the 1st set of stairs in the hedge maze.
- Fixed an issue that would cause the character's meshes legs to respond to to collisions.
- Adjusted a few environment pieces in the level: Archdale Castle.
- Fixed button icons overlapping in the Notes tab of the inventory screen when using Xbox button prompts.

Skulls Of Archdale Guide
Get help unlocking new weapons, achievements and the alternate ending with the official guide on everything about the collectable: Skulls Of Archdale! 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3416881401

3000 Wishlists!
This update celebrates 3000 wishlists for Evil Awaits! Thank you to everyone who has provided positive reviews and feedback, together we are making the adventure through Archdale the best it can be. Look forward to more in the future.

notes.title: Evil Awaits Patch 1.1.0 - New Upgrades, Boss Changes, and Big Improvements
notes.content:
Evil Awaits first major patch is here! 
This patch brings in new upgrades and journals, boss reworks, quality-of-life improvements, balancing and lots more.

New Upgrades
5 New Journals can be found throughout Archdale, all introducing new upgrades at the workbench. 

Ammo Mule - Increase the amount of maximum ammunition for all weapons.

Medkit Capacity - Increase the maximum amount of Medkits you can carry at one time.

Medkit Strength - Increase the effectiveness of Medkits.

Roll Distance - Increase the distance traveled whilst Rolling.

Sprint Speed - Increase the speed of Sprinting.

Additions
- An additional 15 toolkits have been added around Archdale, and more can be found from specific sources.
- Headshots now have a high chance to stagger enemy variants that can be staggered.
- Loot drop system reworked for all lesser enemy variants.
- The ranking system has been re-balanced and now includes Journals found.

Bosses
Bridge
- Slightly increased health across all difficulties.
- Slightly reduced health scaling.

Docks
- Increased health during the second boss phase on Standard difficulty.
- Decreased chance of long spit attack during the second phase.

Cemetery
- Changed behaviour during the first phase.
- Increased health to succeed during phase two on Standard and Hardcore difficulties.

Archdale Castle
- New interactive objects added to the last boss room.
- Last boss reworked with additional animations for new environment interactions.
- Last boss health increased across all difficulties.
- Last boss movement speed increased across all difficulties.

Balance
- Slightly reduced health scaling of lesser enemy variants.
- Light Melee Damage increased from 20 - 25 -> 30 - 35
- Heavy Melee Damage increased from 25 - 35 -> 45 - 55
- Sprint Melee Damage increased from 25 - 35 -> 60 - 75
- More enemies spawn on Standard and Hardcore difficulties in the level: Garden.
- Rifle Max Ammo reduced from 120 -> 90
- SMG Max Ammo increased from 90 -> 120
- Sniper Rifle Max Ammo reduced from 30 -> 12

Improvements and Fixes
- The crosshair setting is now enabled by default.
- Once reaching the Chapel and beyond, the protagonist will now have a dirty/wet cosmetic effect.
- Sniper icon will now appear on the New Game menu when appropriate.
- Cinematics longer than 10 seconds are now skippable in the level: Archdale Castle.
- Both Ending credit screens can now be skipped.
- The Critical Multiplier upgrade now shows the correct information when fully upgraded.
- Journals no longer apply to Notes counted.
- Journals no longer apply to Note-related achievements.
- Fixed an instance that would disable controls after the opening boss cinematic in the level: Docks.
- Fast zombies will now drop Revolver ammunition instead of Pistol if it is equipped.

To celebrate Evil Awaits will be on its first sale since its release, starting today!
20% OFF From 21/11 - 04/12

Thank you to everyone who has played Evil Awaits, and provided positive reviews with feedback.
Look forward to more.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest 2023, Rewards, Player Feedback, updates and More
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/59963c6d3a92883fad9883e6a50797057ff85ebc.jpg
It's a pleasure to be alongside all these wonderful indie games in Steam Next Fest with the improved concept demo of Evil Awaits. Thank you to everyone that has downloaded, played, watched, and wishlist thus far!

Improved Concept Demo
Since the early access demo back in October 2022, improvements, fixes, and additions have all been made to create what we hope is an overall better experience. This could not have happened without the 300+ players that provided feedback, made content, and supported the project in its early stages, thank you. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163314/c5e8f56a4c612bf8cb1eee491ba27cfcbb279d3a.gif

Whilst the concept demo has seen big changes over the past months, it's still a concept demo. This means we intend to make improvements and additions all based on player and community feedback during Steam Next Fest 2023 and until the release of Evil Awaits.

We can't wait to update and apply more to the concept demo as we look into and test suggestions such as a stamina system, keybinding, and more. Here is a list of just a few of the many features we've added thanks to player feedback since the early access demo:

 Medkits - Can now be collected, stored, and used when the player wants instead of on pick-up. Medkits can be used whilst walking and are indicated by a new character animation & charge bar above the player's health pool. (Hold C / LB / L1, must have a Medkit and be below max health).
 Headshots & Criticals - Precise firearms can now deal critical damage to the weak point of all enemies, this scales with damage upgrades and attachments. Additionally, enemies can be staggered with the appropriate weapon or melee attack, (for example A shot to the leg will slow down their approach).
 Difficulty Selection - Available when starting a new game, difficulty selection has been added to adjust the experience towards your skill level. We hope to implement more affixes such as save items and difficulty options in the future.
 Save Infomation - Your in-game time, Difficulty, Medkits, and Toolkits Used have been added to save slot information.
 Interactions - Ammo, Keys, Doors, and anything the player can pick up/use will now be easier to locate whilst using Sprint, melee attacks, dodge rolls, and more.

Support The Project!
Evil Awaits is an indie game project created by a single developer extremely passionate about game development & the survival horror genre with very little budget. We can't wait to develop more and have the design and assets ready for more enemies, weapons, bosses, puzzles, upgrades and so much more.

If you'd like to see Evil Awaits stay in development and release a full game, please consider supporting the Indiegogo page and grabbing yourself some great rewards!
Support Evil Awaits Here!

notes.content:
Fixes
Thanks to all of you that have shared your day 1 experience with the Early Access Demo of Evil Awaits. It has allowed us to see some bugs/issues that had not come up in prior testing. We continue to work towards fixes as players come forward with bug reports, playthroughs, and more.

Update Includes:

 No more random crouching after rolling (Crouch is Now a hold instead of toggle).
 Music will no longer overlap if you skip the 1st encounter.
 Tutorial has SFX when prompted.
 Additional Note Item added.
 Changed similarities in enemy SFX variations. 
 Added Melee Attack to the tutorial. 
 Fixed spelling error in the opening note.
 Changed Special Menu Hotkey from (I) to (B).

If you want to directly impact the updates, fixes, and additions to this Early Access Demo and the future Full Game, please take this short survey: Evil Awaits Player Survey

Rewards & More!
Find out more on Evil Awaits, get a digital Steam copy of the full game, and more rewards!

Check out the Kickstarter for more:Evil Awaits Kickstarter

Another thank you to everyone that has played and taken an interest in Evil Awaits, 
we can't wait to show you more!
